protocol.primary_metric: pooled development-month paired daily 09:30 RankIC delta

hypothesis.acceptance: pass every check of the pre-registered gate on seed 11 before training seed 29
hypothesis.expected_improvement: pooled processed 09:30 RankIC delta versus V2-CSZ >= one baseline block-5 standard error (0.004156918), with the raw view not degrading and no full-day guardrail breach
hypothesis.statement: Freezing the V2 60d CSZ trunk (seed 11) and adding a zero-initialised 320->32->1 residual head that is trained for 1500 steps only on history-valid 09:30 samples, with labels mapped into the V2 checkpoint's frozen per-timestamp z-score statistics, corrects the opening-section residuals the shared wide head cannot express; in-window fit diagnostics are reported here and the paired out-of-sample comparison is a separate predeclared run.

decisions: trunk freeze is enforced by the optimiser scope plus inference-mode trunk outputs; requires_grad_(False) on the trunk switches oneDNN to packed kernels and perturbs non-opening outputs by ~1e-7 relative
only history-valid 09:30 keys with an exchange time of 09:30 receive the correction; every other key is bit-identical to V2-CSZ and missing-history keys fall back to the frozen intercept

observations: The 09:30 correction is added to the float32 trunk output before the float64 target_scale multiplication, and the head is evaluated inside the adapter's prediction chunks; a single all-row head call differs by one float32 ulp (1.49e-8) on CPU, so the exact review mirrors production chunking.
The opening marker is minute-precision (an exact 09:30:30 key also marks True); prediction keys are minute-sampled so this cannot fire outside the opening section.
The checkpoint's open_residual.sample_time is trusted payload metadata; the produced checkpoints carry '09:30' and packaging hashes pin the weights file.

limitations: local approximation: gross forward label returns, no fees/execution/official score
the gate's processed view removes style/industry exposure; the raw 09:30 RankIC gain is larger but was pre-registered as a consistency guardrail only
single seed (11); the dual-seed stage is not reached because the seed-11 screen fails
the style diagnostic explains the delta but is not a gate input; it is archived as context
the checkpoint payload carries seed 11 and schema_version 4 but no experiment/version label, so a packaging provenance step would have to supply the v3-open-20261024 tag
no packaging or platform validation ran for V3-open because the gate stopped the round
